source.adaptation: Original124.79-second CD audio paired with124.27-second riding montage after the dialogue; cue/playlist order authored, not recovered CDDA-controller execution.

account-menu.evidence: The original Dreamcast menu sequence is MISC/SPP004.SND; the native music index identifies SPP004 as Main Menu.

interior.evidence: JOMO MAPINFO SNDD explicitly loads BGM009.SND and starts sequence A83F.

exterior.evidence: Hazuki Residence Grounds intentionally shares the Hazuki Residence Interior music.

yamanose.evidence: JU00 uses SELECT. FREE 1 (Disc 1 FRE0100, STEP 1.x) is the shared early exploration default without simulated story progression.

sakuragaoka.evidence: JD00 uses SELECT and shares the early FREE 1 exploration default with Yamanose and Dobuita.

dobuita.evidence: D000 uses SELECT and shares the early FREE 1 exploration default with Yamanose and Sakuragaoka.

mfsy.evidence: MFSY uses SELECT. FREE 5 (Disc 2 FRE1400, STEP 14.x) was selected for ongoing harbor exploration, rather than the earliest FREE 6.

mksg.evidence: Disc 2 MKSG switches from YKM005 stealth music to SELECT when bank-2 flag 260 is set (at least STEP 13.1). FREE 10 (FRE1300) is the first ordinary exploration default; no story flags are set by this assignment.

mfbt.evidence: MFBT MAPINFO references BGM120.SND for the native 70-man battle scene; this exploration variant shares the selected harbor default until that sequence is rendered.

ma00.evidence: MA00 MAPINFO SNDD explicitly loads BGM062.SND and starts sequence A83F.

ma00race.evidence: The supplied Forklift Racing soundtrack file was selected specifically for the /play race zone.
